name: hcl-mcp
description: Human-centric lighting toolkit as a local MCP server: SPECTRL2/SEDES1 spectral skies from EPW weather, CIE S 026:2018 alpha-opic and melanopic metrics, nvRD alertness, WELL / EN 17037 / EN 12464-1 compliance verdicts, IES photometry, and a run-or-emit Radiance pipeline for daylight, electric-lighting and glare simulation.
